name: Muslim Aid America
mission: Muslim Aid USA (MAUSA) is a faith-based American international charity that provides help to people who are victims of natural disasters or conflict or suffering from poverty, hunger, disease, homelessness, injustice, deprivation or lack of skills and economic opportunities.
scoreSummary: Muslim Aid America shows strong alignment and good impact, with zakat compliance (major risk deductions applied).
zakatClaimEvidence: Muslim Aid USA explicitly states on its 'Zakat' page: "An annual obligation, Zakat is given by eligible adult Muslims whose wealth exceeds the Nisab threshold for a full lunar year. It directs essential support to those in need, both locally and across the globe." It also has a dedicated 'Zakat Policy' and a 'Donate Now' page with an option to 'Offer Your Zakat'. Furthermore, their 'Donation Policy' mentions specific instructions for 'CREDIT CARD DONATIONS FOR ZAKAT'. (Source: https://www.mausa.org/religious-dues/zakat/)
